source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.6.2 (PDF 219-220), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Storytelling mein alfaaz, tasveeron aur jazbat se aisi kahani (narrative) banayi jati hai jo sunne walon ko apne saath jor le. Achhi tarah bani kahani tawajjo kheenchti hai, mushkil khayalat ko aasan banati hai aur paigham yaad rakhne mein madad deti hai. Pakistan mein bohat se school debate (mubahisa) competitions karwate hain jin mein students mukhtalif topics ke haq ya mukhalifat mein dalail dete hain. Achhi storytelling aap ki daleel ko zyada dilchasp aur qail karne wala (persuasive) bana sakti hai.

Misal: agar debate ka topic ho "Kya plastic bags par pabandi honi chahiye?", to samundar ke kinare ki ek sair ka qissa sunana jahan aap ne dekha ke plastic ka kachra samundari janwaron ko nuqsan pohancha raha tha, aap ki daleel ko zyada qareeb aur yaqeen dilane wala bana deta hai.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Storytelling sadiyon se Pakistani saqafat (culture) ka hissa hai. Heer Ranjha aur Sassi Punnu jaisi riwayati kahaniyan nasl dar nasl chali aa rahi hain, jo mohabbat, bahaduri aur qurbani ke qeemti sabaq deti hain.

blocks.prompt: Storytelling karobar ko kaise faida deti hai (short question 6)? Karobar mein storytelling ke liye kaunsi skill sab se zaroori hai (MCQ 9)?
blocks.explanation: MCQ 9: (b) emotional connection (jazbati rishta). Karobar kaise aur kyun shuru hua, ya us ne kisi asal customer ki kaise madad ki, is ki kahani logon ko brand yaad rakhne aur us par bharosa karne mein madad deti hai, product ko aasani se samjhati hai aur customers ko brand ka himayati bana deti hai.

items: Storytelling: alfaaz, tasveerein aur jazbat se kahani; tawajjo kheenchti, baat aasan aur yaadgar banati hai.
